newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Sons Gwalia in full Orion buyout.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Sons Gwalia in full Orion buyout.

text.p: Gold miner Sons of Gwalia Ltd said on Tuesday that it had acceptances from 98.95 percent of Orion Resources NL's shareholders for its A$1.80 per share takeover bid and would proceed with compulsory acquisition of the remaining shares.
Sons of Gwalia said its takeover offer expired later today and the offer would not be extended.

Sons of Gwalia said that after its merger with Burmine Ltd, the acquisition of 61 percent of Gasgoyne Gold Mines NL and the acquisition of Orion Resources, it had gained control of one of the major archaean greenstone belts in Western Australia.
This region included six operating gold mines and three gold mining plants situated at Bullfinch, Marvel Loch and at the Yilgarn Star mine, it said.

"The acquisition of Orion, combined with the Burmine merger and the control of Gasgoyne Gold Mines, has resulted in the company achieving its objective and strategy of consolidating and gaining control of the Southern Cross - Marvel Loch mining
region," Sons of Gwalia Ltd managing director Peter Lalor said.

"The company intends to treat this area as a mining centre where the consolidation of the region and production base will result in attributable gold production for the financial year ended 30 June 1997 of approximately 300,000 fine ounces increasing to approximately 390,000 fine ounces in the 1997/8 year," he said in a statement.
Sons of Gwalia's shares were unchanged at A$8.15 at 2.00 p.m (0300 GMT).
